mode.description: How the organization serves managed settings. In `organization` mode every member receives the organization settings, which are set in claude.ai. In `rbac_groups` mode each member receives the settings of the first RBAC Group in `rbac_group_order` that they belong to. A member in none of them receives the default settings, or no settings if no default is set.

mode_updated_at.title: Mode Updated At
mode_updated_at.description: When the mode last changed, in RFC 3339 format, or `null` if it never has.

rbac_group_order.title: Rbac Group Order
rbac_group_order.description: The ID of every RBAC Group with settings, deleted groups included, highest precedence first.

rbac_group_order_version.title: Rbac Group Order Version
rbac_group_order_version.description: An opaque version of `rbac_group_order`, which changes whenever the order does. Send it back with a new order.
